articles.title: Oura is going public, but these smart ring companies are coming for its crown
articles.author: Aisha Malik
articles.content: While Oura has largely dominated the smart ring market for years, a growing number of rivals are now racing to dethrone it by trying all sorts of approaches to get an edge over it.
